Organization.title: Organization
Organization.intro: An Organization is a management layer over shared workspaces: one sign-in method, directory sync, resource policy and Organization audit. Organization roles only manage the Organization. They never grant access to a workspace, its tasks or content; workspace members are still managed in Members.

unbound.title: This workspace isn't in an Organization
unbound.memberNote: Only a workspace admin can bind this workspace to an Organization.
unbound.body: Once bound, the Organization's sign-in requirements and resource policy apply here, and seats count distinct active members across all its workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own members, tasks and resources.
unbound.bindNote: You need to be an owner or admin of that Organization and an admin of this workspace.
unbound.createNote: You become its owner, then this workspace is bound to it.

bound.notAdmin: This workspace belongs to an Organization
bound.notAdminNote: Only the Organization's owners and admins can see its settings. Your access to this workspace still follows Members.

overview.title: Details
overview.seatsNote: Active members are counted once across all the Organization's workspaces. Agents, bots, devices and pending invitations don't take a seat.
overview.planFreeNote: Single sign-on, SCIM, resource policy and Organization audit export need Enterprise. Mikka turns it on by hand for now; send us the Organization ID below.
overview.overLimit: Active members are over the limit of {limit}. Existing members and data are kept, but no one new can join until you're back under it.

workspaces.title: Bound workspaces
workspaces.description: Each workspace keeps its own members, tasks and resource permissions. Organization admins don't see a workspace's content because of this.
workspaces.unbindBody: The Organization's sign-in requirements and resource policy stop applying here, and seats are counted for this workspace alone again. Its members and content don't change; the Organization's audit records are kept.
workspaces.notMember: A workspace you're not a member of
workspaces.ownMembers: Members and content are managed by the workspace itself

invitations.joined: You joined the Organization as a Member. Workspace access is unchanged.
invitations.description: Organization members can invite another Member. No workspace access is granted.
invitations.title: Invite Organization members
invitations.label: Email addresses
invitations.hint: Up to 20 addresses, separated by commas or new lines.
invitations.sent: Invitation links are shown only once. Copy and share them securely. Configured email delivery is attempted separately and is not confirmed by this response.
invitations.copyFailed: Could not copy the invitation link.

members.title: Organization admins and members
members.description: Organization members can invite new members. Only owners and admins can change roles and manage workspace governance.
members.removeBody: Suspends them in every workspace of this Organization and revokes their tokens, runs and shares there. Their personal account, personal workspace and other Organizations aren't affected; rejoining later doesn't restore their old role.
members.addNote: Choose an existing account from this workspace's members; an email alone can't add anyone. Joining the Organization gives no workspace access.
members.noCandidates: Everyone in this workspace is already in the Organization.

archive.title: Danger zone
archive.label: Archive Organization
archive.body: Unbind every workspace first, this one included, and turn off every sign-in method and SCIM connection. After archiving, its audit records are kept under the retention period and legal hold.

identity.title: Sign-in and directory
identity.needsEnterprise: Single sign-on and SCIM need Enterprise
identity.needsEnterpriseNote: Without it you can still turn off existing sign-in methods, revoke SCIM, stop enforcing SSO and use owner recovery.

providers.title: Single sign-on
providers.description: Sign in with your identity provider (OIDC or SAML 2.0). Each method works only after its domain is verified. Existing accounts with the same email are never merged automatically.
providers.emptyNote: After adding one, publish the verification record in DNS and register the callback address with your identity provider.
providers.disableBody: Sessions signed in with it lose their SSO status and its SCIM connection is revoked. If the Organization enforces SSO, those members need another sign-in method or owner recovery.
providers.unverifiedNote: Publish the TXT record below in DNS, then verify.
providers.unverifiedLost: The verification value is shown only once, when you save. Save this sign-in method again to get a new one.
providers.signInNote: Sign in again with this method. You need this before enforcing SSO.
providers.linkNote: Link your existing Mikka account to the same person at your identity provider. You need to have signed in within the last 5 minutes.

setup.title: Finish setting up the sign-in method
setup.description: These values are shown only after this save. Register them in DNS and with your identity provider, then verify the domain.
setup.dnsOnce: Shown only this once. After you leave, save the sign-in method again to get a new value.
setup.postLogoutNote: Register this separately in your identity provider's logout redirect allowlist, apart from the sign-in callback.
setup.samlLogoutNote: SAML single logout uses your identity provider's logout address and ends only the sessions of that SAML sign-in.
setup.verifyNote: DNS records can take a few minutes to take effect.
setup.verified: Domain verified. The sign-in method is ready.

scim.title: SCIM directory sync
scim.description: Your identity provider syncs users and groups over SCIM 2.0. Deactivating or deleting a directory user blocks their sign-in at once and revokes their access to this Organization's workspaces. Groups sync directory information only and grant no workspace access.
scim.onceTitle: Copy and save the SCIM credential
scim.onceNote: It's shown only this once; Mikka never shows it again.
scim.saved: Once it's saved in your identity provider, closing this removes it from the page.
scim.emptyNote: Create a SCIM credential on a verified sign-in method.
scim.needsVerified: Verify a sign-in method's domain first.
scim.revokeBody: Your identity provider can't sync anymore. Synced users lose their Organization identity and their access to this Organization's workspaces; personal accounts aren't affected.
scim.connectionNote: Created {date}. Creating a credential again replaces the old one.

policy.title: Sign-in requirements
policy.description: Apply to every workspace in this Organization.
policy.enforceNote: When on, Organization workspaces can only be opened after signing in with this Organization's SSO. Use “Sign in with SSO” first, or turning it on is refused.
policy.machineNote: Lets personal access tokens and devices keep working in Organization workspaces while SSO is required.
policy.retryNote: After turning off, revoking or tightening, revocations retry in the background. Use this to try again right away.

breakGlass.title: Owner recovery
breakGlass.description: If your identity provider is unavailable, an owner can bypass required SSO for a short time to turn it off or fix the configuration. It applies only to the current session and every use is recorded in the Organization audit.
breakGlass.activeNote: Applies only to this session and ends on its own.
breakGlass.placeholder: e.g. The identity provider certificate expired; need to stop requiring SSO
breakGlass.hint: At least 10 characters. You need to have signed in within the last 5 minutes; it lasts 15 minutes.

form.logoutHint: Optional; one each for the Redirect and POST bindings.
form.replaceNote: Saving replaces any configuration with the same ID: existing SSO sign-ins lose their status and the domain must be verified again.

policy.title: Resource sharing policy
policy.description: Decides whether members can share their own API keys and MCP into Organization workspaces (subscriptions serve their owner only and cannot be shared). Sharing still needs the resource's own permission; this policy can only make it stricter.

modelCredentialSharing.label: Model credentials
modelCredentialSharing.note: Members sharing API keys. Subscriptions serve their owner only.

providers.label: Allowed model sources
providers.note: Runs in Organization workspaces can use only the checked sources.
providers.none: Choose at least one source, or Organization workspaces can't run models.

retention.label: Organization audit retention
retention.note: Expired Organization audit records are deleted. Deletion pauses while an export is open or legal hold is on.

legalHold.label: Legal hold
legalHold.note: While on, no Organization audit record is deleted and retention doesn't apply.

policy.tightenNote: When you tighten it, shares that no longer fit are withdrawn and their runs stop.

approvals.title: Sharing approvals
approvals.description: With “Needs approval”, shared resources wait here. Denying withdraws the resource from the workspace; approving never bypasses the resource's own permission.
approvals.emptyNote: Requests appear when members share API keys or MCP into Organization workspaces.

audit.title: Organization audit
audit.description: The Organization's administrative events: members and roles, workspace binding, sign-in methods, directory sync, policy and exports. No tokens, assertions or workspace content.
